buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): BOO Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: BOO 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Clarification Regarding Contents of the Bid. 1.1. For Bidder. A prospective bidder who requires clarification regarding the contents of the bidding docu ments shall notify to the Buyer in writing about the clarifications sought not later than 7 (seven) days prior to the date of opening of the Bid. Copies of the query should be forwarded to HQ 654 EME Bn, PIN-906654 c/o 56 APO and thotasuresh.832f@gov.in. 1.2. For Purchaser. During evaluation and comparison of bids, the Buyer may, at its discretion, ask the bidd er for clarification of his bid. The requested for clarification will be given in writing and no change in prices or substance of the bid will be sought, offered or permitted. No post-bid clarification on the initiative of the bidder will be entertained. 2 Document required to be submitted along with Bid for Technical Evaluation:- 2.1. Copy of PAN Card/GSTIN/Cancelled Cheque of firm.

2.2. Past performance/ experience for last three years with similar category of (b) product. 2.3. Bidder turnover of firms last three years duly audited by CA. 2.4. OEM turnover of firms last three years duly audited by CA. 2.5. Undertaking on Bidder financial standing. 2.6. Malware/ Vulnerability & malicious code cert as per Appx 'A'. 2.7. Technical compliance matrix with make and model as per Appx 'B'. 2.8. OEM Authorization certificate. 2.9. Non-disclosure of contract cert. 3. Delivery period. Within 60 days from date of placement of Supply order. In case the firm anticipates dela y in supply due to any unforeseen reasons, the firm will bring it to the notice of purchaser who after consid ering the reasons as valid and beyond firm's control may give extension of time. This extension request m ust however be made minimum seven days before expiry of the said deliver period of 60 days. However, p urchaser reserves the right to recover from the firm liquidated because of delay in delivery. 4. Acceptance Testing. Within 45 days from effective date of delivery of complete 5. Payment terms & condition. 100% payment after completion of 30 days from 6. Timely servicing/ rectification of defect during warranty period. After having been noticed of defect/ serv ice requirement during warranty period, seller has to complete the required service/ rectification within se ven days' time limit. If the seller fails to complete the service/ rectification within defined time limit a penal ty of 0.5% of unit price of product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from seller. 7. Secrecy. The contractor shall ensure all persons on any work in connection with this contract have been noticed that the Official Secret Act 1923 (XIX of 1923) is applicable to them. 8. Bidder should submit an undertaking on the letterhead of the firm about non-debarment/no blacklisting/ no any forfeiture during the last two years by any Govt./PSU/Central or State agencies. In the absence of t he said undertaking, the bid will be summarily rejected. (Affidavit on 100 Stamp Paper) 9. Bidder or Reseller should submit a declaration about the agreed supply as per the specification. 10. Upload Manufacturer Authorization: Wherever Authorized Distributors are submitting the bid, the Manu facturer's Authorization Form (MAF)/Certificate with OEM details such as name, designation, address, e-ma il ID, and phone number is required to be furnished along with the bid. 11. As per the State Government's Vocal for Local Policy vide Govt Notification No. MIDSP/19/2021-1/1 dat ed 2nd November 2021, preference shall be for the firm registered in the consignee location. (Supporting d ocument to be submitted) 12. The firm is to submit proof of experience of having successfully supplied the same or a similar item duri ng the last 3 years. From any Central Govt./State Govt./PSU/Public Listed Companies as per GeM. 13. The bidder has to submit MSME/ Udyam Certificate, GST Certificate. 14. The material should be supplied from ISO 14001:2015, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 Certified Manu facturer. 15. The bidder has to submit a pre-bid meet for clarity on technical specification. 16. Valid character certificate issued by any Government Officer. 17. Rating on GeM portal must be 4+. 18. GST 3B CHALLAN OF THE LAST 6 MONTHS. 19. Bid Specific MAF of Manufacturer for Onsite Support & Warranty. 20. Sample must be provided before Bid Opening, without this bid is liable to reject. 21. GeM portal user (Silver certificate) and GeM Expert (Gold Certificate).

22. An Office of service provider must be located in Telangana state. Documentary evidence with telephon e number to be submitted for ease of communication, as the bidder is dealing with Defence organization w here the life of soldier and security is paramount. 23. Submission of bid-specific MAF for onsite support and warranty. 24. Rejection Criteria. 24.1. Incomplete or incorrect documentation. 24.2. Non-compliance with any of the eligibility or technical specifications. 24.3. Failure to submit the required affidavits or certifications. 24.4. Lack of satisfactory past performance as per GeM records. 25. Right to Reject. 25.1. The buyer reserves the right to reject any or all bids without assigning any reason. 25.2. The buyer also reserves the right to restrict participation based on past performance or any other rel evant criteria. 26. Legal Compliance. NOTE:- Trails will be conducted during TEC, All Bidders must be participate in Trails. Bidder fail to attend tr ails liable to reject In TEC. .
